text.p: Petrofields Exploration and Development Co Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors had approved a one-for-four rights offer.
In an advisory, Petrofields said it would raise 200 million pesos from the stock rights to partly cover for the 800 million peso increase in its capital.
Details of the offering were not disclosed.
Petrofields said it will seek approval for the rights offer with the Securities and Exchange Commission by the second week of July.
Petrofields earlier said it was increasing its capital to 1.6 billion pesos from 800 million pesos to finance its diversification programme.
The board of Petrofields has approved the change from an oil exploration company into a development and investment management firm.
